name: Spirit: Summoners of Áine-Chlair
source:
Minazuki "Damian" Daigo is a 23-year-old wolf who is cheerful, optimistic and simple to the point of being ditzy — this, however, concealed his tragic past experiences. 

After leaving his hometown, Rougetsu Village, Damian came to Asou City, working as a wage earner in Happy Street Mall and hoping that he would spend his entire life surrounded by people who would not miss him but around so many smiles and laughs.

However, as rumors of people in Asou City start to go missing one after another starting to spread, Damian encounters a kobold-looking creature. From that moment on, his life would never be the same again...

[From [url=https://ghostrickfrost.itch.io/spirit-summoners-aine-chlair]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
水无月“达米安”醍醐是一只23岁的狼，开朗、乐观、单纯到了昏昏欲睡的地步——但这却掩盖了他悲惨的过去经历。

离开故乡月月村后，达米安来到了阿苏市，在快乐街购物中心打工，希望自己的一生都能被那些不会想念他的人包围着，周围有那么多的笑容和笑声。

然而，随着阿苏市有人失踪的谣言开始不断传播，达米安遇到了一种看起来像狗头人的生物。从那一刻起，他的生活就不再一样了……

[来自[url=https://ghostrickfrost.itch.io/spirit-summoners-aine-chlair]Itch.io[/url]]
